messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a **complete list of the long‑weekend holidays that apply nationwide in Canada for 2023** (i.e., federal holidays that fall on a Friday or a Saturday, giving you a 3‑day weekend).  
If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day, Easter Monday, etc.) let me know and I can add those too.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1 – 3** (Sunday – Tuesday) | Observed on Monday Jan 2 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7 – 9** (Friday – Sunday) | Federal holiday |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 20 – 22** (Saturday – Monday) | Federal holiday |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1 – 3** (Saturday – Monday) | Federal holiday |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2 – 4** (Saturday – Monday) | Federal holiday |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7 – 9** (Saturday – Monday) | Federal holiday |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | **Nov 11 – 13** (Saturday – Monday) | Federal holiday |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23 – 25** (Saturday – Monday) | Federal holiday |
